title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
changes_from_base: An egg-free browned-butter pumpkin cookie bar with dark chocolate chips, in place of shortbread, caramel and chocolate layers.
summary: Egg-free brown butter pumpkin cookie bars with dark chocolate chips.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 170 g for the dough, 40 g for the top

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan) and line the 20 cm tin.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Melt the butter in a small pan and cook, stirring, about 7 min until it smells nutty and the solids turn amber. Scrape into a large bowl and whisk in the spices.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Tip the pumpkin into the same pan and cook over medium heat, stirring, 7-9 min until darker and thick (about 95 g). Whisk into the spiced butter and cool 20 min.

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Whisk both sugars and the vanilla into the pumpkin butter. Mix the flour, salt and bicarbonate of soda, fold them in, then fold in 170 g chocolate chips.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin, press the rest of the chips on top and bake 25-30 min, until the top looks dry and a skewer shows only melted chocolate.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin, then cut into 12.

tips: Cooking down the pumpkin removes water and keeps the bars chewy.
Use plain pumpkin purée, not pie filling.
Brown the butter until amber, not black.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
